messages.subject: Tracking usage
parts:
Hi all,

i have written a specific GUI that allows the user to upload a CSV file (that contains certain data), and returns an error report.
so basicaly this reduces the need for microsoft access or excels logic check, which saves time.

My question is:
is there a way, when a person uploads a csv file with 1000 data sets, and it runs through my codes, generates this error report with 10 problems
i wish to internally store a file on the server the number of entries of the orginial file, and the number of errors in the orginal file, and the percentage
something like (to track whether the percentage of error is decreasing over time)

Date            Time    Number of tests    Error found Percentage
dd/mm/yy    xx/xx    1000                          10          1%
is there a way to do it? the file can be in any form, a text file or a csv file, that i can retrieve from the server later on.

messages.subject: Re: Tracking usage
parts: Sure--it's just R code. In your code that processes the upload, you can just save the data to disk using write.csv or whatever.
